messages.content: Just to confirm, that refund is only for the two broken jars, not the whole order, right?

Yes, confirmed. The full order total was $31.50 for 6 jars, and we only refunded $12.50 — which covers 2 of the 6 jars (consistent with $31.50 ÷ 6 ≈ $5.25/jar × 2 ≈ $10.50... actually the per-jar price works out to ~$5.25, so $12.50 was the amount you specified, not a calculated per-jar amount).

To be precise: we refunded exactly the $12.50 you requested, not the full $31.50 order total.
